function.name: dictionary_create
function.description: This function creates a new dictionary structure and initializes its members. It allocates memory for the dictionary and assigns the provided compare function, destroy function, and extra data to the corresponding members of the dictionary. If the compare function is not provided, the function returns NULL.

parameters.name: c
parameters.description: This is a function pointer used for comparing dictionary entries.

parameters.name: d
parameters.description: This is a function pointer used for destroying dictionary entries.

parameters.name: extra
parameters.description: This is a pointer to extra data that can be used for any purpose.

function.return_type: struct dictionary*, represents a pointer to the newly created dictionary. If the compare function is not provided, the function returns NULL.

function.name: dictionary_destroy
function.description: This function destroys a dictionary, freeing up the memory allocated to it and its entries. It also calls a destroy function on each entry if one is defined.
function.return_type: void, as it does not return anything.

function.name: dictionary_num_entries
function.description: This function returns the number of entries in the given dictionary.

parameters.name: d
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the dictionary whose number of entries is to be returned.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the number of entries in the dictionary.

function.name: dictionary_insert
function.description: This function inserts a key-value pair into a dictionary. If the key already exists, it updates the value. If the key does not exist, it creates a new dictionary entry. If the dictionary has a destroy function, it will be called on the old key-value pair before the update.

parameters.name: d
parameters.description: Pointer to the dictionary where the key-value pair will be inserted

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: Pointer to the key of the key-value pair to be inserted

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: Pointer to the value of the key-value pair to be inserted

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: dictionary_find
function.description: This function searches for a key in the dictionary and returns the corresponding value if the key is found.

parameters.name: d
parameters.description: Pointer to the dictionary to search in.

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: Pointer to the key to search for.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer. If the key is found, this location is updated to point to the corresponding value.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the key is found, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: dictionary_remove
function.description: This function removes an entry from a dictionary. If a destroy function is provided when the dictionary was created, it will be called on the key and value of the removed entry.

parameters.name: d
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the dictionary from which an entry is to be removed.

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the key of the entry to be removed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: dictionary_enumerate
function.description: This function iterates over each entry in the dictionary and applies the function 'e' to it. If 'e' returns false, the iteration stops.

parameters.name: d
parameters.description: Pointer to the dictionary to be enumerated

parameters.name: e
parameters.description: Function to be applied to each entry in the dictionary

parameters.name: closure
parameters.description: Pointer to a closure that is passed to the function 'e'

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value
